nodes.notes: ANALYSIS: (1) Classification: Swin transformer block (fp16): LN + shifted-window MSA (num_heads=1, head_dim=32, window=4x4=16 tokens, shift=0 -> no shift/mask needed) + residual + LN + MLP(4x expansion, GELU) + residual. Input [1,720,1280,32]. No padding needed (720%4=0, 1280%4=0). Stochastic_depth p=0 or eval mode typically. (2) Canonical: x1 = x + Proj(Attn(LN(x))); out = x1 + MLP2(GELU(MLP1(LN(x1)))). Attention per window of 16 tokens with head_dim=32: Q@K^T scaled + rel_pos_bias, softmax, @V. (3) Layout: Input NHWC fp16 contiguous. qkv_weight [96,32], proj_weight [32,32], mlp1 [128,32], mlp2 [32,128]. Window partition reshape+permute is a memory copy. (4) Regimes: (a) elementwise/LN bound - fuse LN with residual & window-partition reshape; (b) attention compute - tiny 16x16 per window, many windows -> batched GEMM dominates; (c) MLP - dim 32->128->32 GEMMs are small/thin, bandwidth-bound. (5) Knobs: fuse LN+partition, fuse attention (QKV proj+softmax+AV+Oproj) per window using Triton since window is only 16 tokens, fuse GELU+bias, fuse residual+LN. Keep GEMMs via torch.matmul/F.linear where they dominate; with num_heads=1 and head_dim=32 entire attention can be a single Triton kernel per window batch. (6) Skeleton: Kernel A: fused LN over last dim + optional window-partition write. Kernel B: fused windowed attention (load Q,K,V tiles [16,32]x3 per window, compute attn + bias + softmax + AV + Oproj using weight tile [32,32] loaded once per block). Kernel C: fused residual-add + LN. Kernel D: MLP fused (GEMM via matmul + fused GELU+bias inline). Kernel E: final residual add. (7) Candidates families listed below.

kernel_summary: Swin transformer block in fp16 on [1,720,1280,32]: LayerNorm -> shifted-window MHSA (num_heads=1, head_dim=32, window=4x4, shift=0) -> residual -> LayerNorm -> MLP(32->128->32, GELU) -> residual, with optional stochastic depth. With shift=0 and H,W divisible by window size, the shift/pad/mask paths are dead. Main cost is memory-bound LN/residual/GELU glue and many tiny windowed attention matmuls (57600 windows of 16 tokens, head_dim=32). Key constraints: preserve fp16 I/O with fp32 LN accumulation, reuse cuBLAS tensor-core GEMMs for qkv/proj/mlp1/mlp2 where profitable, and fuse memory-bound ops in Triton.
